text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Yeah! Thank you so much! Hearing you say that gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I almost forgot. My dream's not just my dream anymore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, time to snap out of this funk! Let's keep at it—starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …You're totally right. If I give up now, then I'm really done for!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I love races, and I'll never let go of my dream to win! Today's the start of working even harder for first place!
